texto: For th e third quarter fiscal 2027, UiPath expects:
• Revenue in the range of $440 million to $445 million
• ARR in the range of $1.992 billion to $1.997 billion as of October 31, 2026
• Revenue of $410 million increased 13 percent year-over-year.
• ARR of $1.938 billion as of July 31, 2026 increased 12 percent year-over-year.
• Dollar based net retention rate of 109 percent.

We offer free trials and a free tier of our platform to drive awareness of our products, and encourage use and adoption. If these marketing strategies fail to lead to customers purchasing paid licenses, our ability to grow our revenue will be adversely affected.
Seasonality may cause fluctuations in our sales and results of operations.
If we cannot maintain our corporate culture as we grow, our success and our business and competitive position may be harmed.
